title: Sri Lanka Couple Circuit
headline: Cultural cities, a hill-country train, then the south coast.
description: Seven nights for two: Sigiriya and Kandy, a stretch in the hills, then Galle or a southern beach.
image_alt: Nine Arches Bridge and a train in the hills near Ella, Sri Lanka
price_label: Quoted for your circuit and dates
price_guidance: Sri Lanka pricing depends on hotel category, whether the hill-country train is booked, and beach town. We confirm a written total before you reserve.
overview: A couple’s island circuit: rock fortress and cave temples in the cultural triangle, a night near Kandy, tea country around Ella, then the south coast. Private vehicle between stays; the train is added when seats exist.
highlights: Sigiriya or Pidurangala at a sane hour.
Temple of the Tooth in Kandy.
Hill-country train or a scenic road to Ella.
Two nights on the south coast — Galle Fort or a quieter beach.
why: Culture, hills and sea in one week, without rushing every site.
Pace and dining can be shaped around the two of you.
ETA guidance for Indian passports, coordinated with your tickets.
inclusions: Airport and inter-hotel transfers in a private vehicle
Hill-country train seats when they can be confirmed in your quote
exclusions: Site tickets, safari jeeps and optional whale-watching unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

stay.name: Selected boutique hotels on a four-stop circuit
amenities: Air conditioning or fans as the property offers

notes: Train seats, site tickets and beach town are confirmed only after you approve the written quote. Some climbs close in heavy rain. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: Suggested order through the cultural triangle, Kandy, Ella and the south. A stop can be dropped for more beach time.
